the emotional salary is an important tool to improve the quality of life of the worker.

the development of a model that is based on the emotional salary and that is applied to the context of Medellin.
the development of an emotional salary that is articulated through strategic management of human talents in organisations.
the emotional salary as a tool that allows to measure the satisfaction of the worker in the organisation, as well as his/her commitment, and the level of his/her productivity.

an emotional salary model would be an effective tool for the strategic management of the human talent in the companies.

the emotional salary is an organisational policy that is not only a benefit for the workers, but also a benefit for the companies, since they can improve their performance and productivity.

the emotional salary is a tool that can be used to measure the productivity and the quality of work life in organisations, which is why the emotional salary is considered a strategy for the strategic management of talent in companies.

an emotional salary model allows the companies to have the opportunity to increase their productivity, since the employees feel satisfied, and this allows the companies to increase their productivity and competitiveness.

the emotional salary model is an important instrument for measuring the emotional state of the workers in the companies, and it is an indicator of the level of satisfaction that they feel in relation to their work, and the level of commitment that they have to the company.

the salary model is not a tool that allows the company to measure the productivity and satisfaction of its personnel, so it is important to implement an emotional salary model to measure productivity and the satisfaction of the personnel.
